# Private Actors, the firms' sectors: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-28-actors-firms-design.md
# (§ 5.1, § 8.1, § 10.1). Hand-set inputs: scripts/generators/private_actors_config.py.

# Scope: a company. Its sector has the feature (the flag te_pa_gen_assess wrote).

# fossil: The three building types the Resource Transition laws act on: their INJECTs in
# common/buildings/extra_buildings.txt gate construction on rt_fossil_construction_allowed_here, and Managed
# Fossil Phaseout's programmes retire them (docs/systems/mod_systems/global_warming.md). Company flagships
# that dig coal or pump oil are left out, as the laws leave them out.
te_pa_gen_is_fossil = { var:te_pa_g_f_fossil ?= 1 }

# financial: No building type in vanilla or the mod is a bank, so a building rule finds no financial firm.
# These are the companies whose history is banking or investment: SoftBank's Vision Fund; the Yasuda, Mitsui,
# Sumitomo and Mitsubishi zaibatsu, each built round its bank; the Nederlandsche Handel-Maatschappij, later
# ABN AMRO; Jardine Matheson's banking and insurance.
te_pa_gen_is_financial = { var:te_pa_g_f_financial ?= 1 }

# automatable: A building type with a robotic or AI-managed method: the marker the Automation Policy laws act
# on (building_robotic_or_ai_managed_bool in a method's unscaled block;
# docs/systems/mod_systems/automation_policy.md).
te_pa_gen_is_automatable = { var:te_pa_g_f_automatable ?= 1 }

# manufacturing: bg_manufacturing and below (light, heavy, military and high-tech industry, shipyards,
# construction).
te_pa_gen_is_manufacturing = { var:te_pa_g_f_manufacturing ?= 1 }

# extraction: bg_extraction and below (mines, logging, rubber, whaling, fishing, oil): what Extraction Economy
# names.
te_pa_gen_is_extraction = { var:te_pa_g_f_extraction ?= 1 }

# agriculture: bg_agriculture (farms, vineyards) and bg_ranching (ranches): the rural owners' sector
# Agrarianism favors.
te_pa_gen_is_agriculture = { var:te_pa_g_f_agriculture ?= 1 }

# plantation: bg_plantations, the group Industry Banned's and Extraction Economy's throughput lines name. The
# rubber plantation sits under bg_extraction in vanilla and counts as extraction.
te_pa_gen_is_plantation = { var:te_pa_g_f_plantation ?= 1 }

# infrastructure: bg_infrastructure and below (ports, railways, highways, airports, networks, trade centers,
# canals).
te_pa_gen_is_infrastructure = { var:te_pa_g_f_infrastructure ?= 1 }

# power: bg_power and below (power plants, clean power): the utilities of § 6.2's Regulated Utilities row.
te_pa_gen_is_power = { var:te_pa_g_f_power ?= 1 }

# consumer_good: The main output is a staple or luxury good some pop need lists (common/pop_needs/): sold to
# households. Industrial goods pops also buy (coal and oil for heating, glass) are left out.
te_pa_gen_is_consumer_good = { var:te_pa_g_f_consumer_good ?= 1 }

# collectivizable: A building in a group Guild System, Factory Councils and Cooperative Ownership open to
# collectivization (building_group_<bg>_allowed_collectivization_add): manufacturing, extraction, power,
# private infrastructure and arts.
te_pa_gen_is_collectivizable = { var:te_pa_g_f_collectivizable ?= 1 }

# subsidized: A building type Interventionism makes require subsidies
# (country_building_<x>_require_subsidies_bool).
te_pa_gen_is_subsidized = { var:te_pa_g_f_subsidized ?= 1 }

# rm_industry_banned: A building type Industry Banned's on_activate removes from every state.
te_pa_gen_is_rm_industry_banned = { var:te_pa_g_f_rm_industry_banned ?= 1 }

# rm_extraction_economy: A building type Extraction Economy's on_activate removes from every state.
te_pa_gen_is_rm_extraction_economy = { var:te_pa_g_f_rm_extraction_economy ?= 1 }

# Scope: a company. A type that is not a firm (private_actors_config.EXCLUDED_COMPANY_TYPES).
te_pa_gen_excluded_type = {
	OR = {
		is_company_type = company_type:company_gm_name_carrier
	}
}

# Scope: a company. Its seat can take a private level of one of its building types (te_pa_gen_expand's).
te_pa_gen_can_expand = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			is_company_type = company_type:company_a_markwald_and_company
			var:te_pa_seat ?= {
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_rice_farm
						is_building_type = building_port
						is_building_type = building_markwald_bangkok_rice_mill
					}
					can_queue_building_levels = 1
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			is_company_type = company_type:company_airbus
			var:te_pa_seat ?= {
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_aerospace_industry
						is_building_type = building_motor_industry
						is_building_type = building_airbus_lagardere_plant
					}
					can_queue_building_levels = 1
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			is_company_type = company_type:company_ajinomoto
			var:te_pa_seat ?= {
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_food_industry
